proofUses.reason: Replace cosine splitting by the polynomial displacement inequality; all nonnegative chain sums retain their bounds.
An exact change of variables reduces the marked core to a weighted triangle; power convolution and shell sums supply finiteness.
Critical diagram domination gives uniform weighted tails and dominated convergence at every order.
Absolute higher moments justify the Holder Hessian and Taylor remainder, followed by the existing critical moment identities.
